title: Spa Night, Mandatory
description: A pink spa night at home: puffy headband, rose quartz roller and gua sha, silk sleep mask, lavender bath bombs, pastel claw clips and fuzzy slippers.
intro: Self-care gets a bad name because it usually means buying one candle and calling it a personality. This is the version I actually use: a puffy pink headband so my hair stays out of the way, rose quartz to roll out a long day, a lavender silk sleep mask, lavender bath bombs, a pile of pastel claw clips and slippers I refuse to take off. Six finds. The tub, the tea and the candles are yours.

sections.heading: Hair up first, always
paragraphs: The headband set is the start of the whole routine. You get the puffy pink spa headband, a terry bow headband and a pair of wristbands, which sound silly until you wash your face without water running down your arms.

Then the claw clips. The pastel set is 12 matte square clips about 4.3 inches long in pink, mint, sage and blue, big enough to hold a full twist of hair. Keep a few in the bathroom and the rest everywhere else, because you will lose them.

sections.heading: Rose quartz, because it feels good
paragraphs: The roller and gua sha come as a set in pale pink rose quartz with a rose gold frame on the roller. The gua sha is a flat stone about 4 inches long that fits in your hand. Use either one over a face oil or serum so it glides instead of tugging.
Keep them somewhere you will see them. The whole point is the two minutes at night where you are not looking at your phone.

sections.heading: Then the bath, then bed
paragraphs: The lavender bath bombs are palm-sized, 60 grams each, individually wrapped, so they do not crumble in the drawer. Drop one in, then go find your tea.

The sleep mask is lavender mulberry silk with an elastic strap, about 9 inches wide, soft enough that it does not leave lines. The slippers are dusty pink faux fur with memory foam, and yes, they are the most-used thing on this list.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the headband set, the rose quartz set, the silk sleep mask, the bath bombs, the claw clips and the slippers. The tub, tray, candles, towels, mirror, tea, bedding and clothing in these photos are styling extras.

Several of these come in more than one color or pack size, so choose the one you want on the listing. Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item and contents before you buy.
